title: Reduce call latency: off-thread denoiser, frame batching, TCP no-delay
summary: Cut end-to-end talk latency by moving the DTLN denoiser into a Web Worker (denoiser-worker.js) so heavy inference no longer blocks the realtime send path, with a transparent main-thread fallback. Encrypted audio frames are now batched into a single WebSocket message with a flush timer, and a matching decryptBatch runs on receive. The relay disables perMessageDeflate and sets TCP_NODELAY on sockets to stop Nagle buffering. Added server/README.md guidance on region selection and keeping a free instance warm.
userVisibleChange: Lower, more consistent voice-call latency and less audio jitter during calls.
